article.title: Your National Political Committee newsletter — Cool weather, hot DSA wins
article.author: DSA National: NPC Dispatch and Newsletter
article.content: Enjoy your November National Political Committee (NPC) newsletter! Our NPC is an elected 27-person body (including both YDSA Co-Chairs) which functions as the board of directors of DSA. This month, check out electoral wins, take a labor solidarity pledge, find out more about our arms embargo campaign, and more! And to make sure you get our newsletters in your inbox, sign up here! Each one features action alerts, upcoming events, political education, and more. From the National Political Committee — Cool Weather, Hot DSA Wins Fall Drive Has Launched! Win Your Exclusive T-Shirt DSA Arms Embargo — Check Out Video, Sign Up to Get Involved Join our Growth and Development Committee’s Organizing Trainings, Phonebanks, and More Starting Sunday 11/22 Give to DSA’s Venezuela Earthquake Solidarity Fund RSVP to National Political Education Committee Trainings Thursday 12/10, 12/17 Apply to Join the National Grievance Panel, Committee of Grievance Officers Mutual Aid Working Group Logo Redesign Contest Welcome New Chapters and Organizing Committees! From the National Political Committee — Cool Weather, Hot DSA Wins As the weather cools down, DSA organizing is heating up! Our wave of electoral wins earlier this month shows that our ideas are popular and practical, and that DSA members are putting in the work to make real, lasting change where we live and across the country. More than 120 DSA nationally and locally endorsed candidates won their elections. And chapters ran dozens of successful ballot campaigns to tax the rich, protect trans kids, stand up for housing justice, and more! More than 1000 people joined our post-election call — more on that from Southern electeds, Teamsters organizer Tony Rosario, and Young Democratic Socialists of America chapter leaders here! Our endorsed candidates included labor organizers, teachers, healthcare workers, and more. They’ve already been fighting to end the genocide in Palestine, tax billionaires, protect our communities from ICE, and more. Once in office, they’ll continue to speak out for working class people and help build a movement for the many, not the money. Recently, we had the chance to speak to Richard D. Wolff, professor of economics and co-founder of Democracy at Work. During our discussion, Professor Wolff said that he’d spoken with his neighbors about Zohran Mamdani. Even the ones less engaged with politics knew that a politician willing to call themselves a socialist was different from Republicans and establishment Democrats — and they wanted that difference! Leaning forward, Professor Wolff spoke directly to us, and to DSA members like you across the country. “You underestimate how powerful you are, because of the moment in which you exist… The organization you’re building — crucial… It’s for you, the future. And if you go for it, you can get it.” You can see the whole video here. Professor Wolff is right, and working class people know it. That’s why DSA joins increased over 650% after Election Day! DSA chapters and members are heating things up, and YOU have the power to come together for a brighter future. Here’s what you can do today to protect our communities, support worker organizing, and grow our movement: If you’re new to DSA, or you’re coming back to the movement, welcome! Reach out to your chapter today to get involved. Do you live in a state with a Democratic party Senator? Tell them that working class people want Chuck Schumer out and a new Senate Majority Leader in! In case you missed it, we’re boycotting Starbucks this holiday season! Support Starbucks Workers United by taking the boycott pledge with our DSA National Labor Commission and DSA members across the country. You can hear from Starbucks workers about the boycott here. Stand against surveillance and ICE’s terrorizing of our communities — get involved with the DSA International Migrant Rights Working Group’s national campaign to Block Flock today! Read on for more organizing trainings, volunteer opportunities, and more. Let’s keep the wins coming! Solidarity, Ashik Siddique and Megan Romer DSA National Political Committee Co-Chairs Fall Drive Has Launched! Win Your Exclusive T-Shirt DSA’s National Fall Membership Drive has launched and will run through the end of the year! All DSA members can create a unique recruitment link on the national leaderboard here. DSA members who recruit five or more new members using their unique link will receive this limited edition t-shirt! Members can also get involved in the Fall Membership Drive by filling out this form. DSA Arms Embargo — Check Out Video, Sign Up to Get Involved On October 29th, the National Arms Embargo Organizing Committee hosted our national campaign launch call, where we heard from campaign, organization, and movement leaders about our new Elbit Out and United campaigns and what it would take to achieve a total arms embargo! If you’d like to watch the launch, you can find the video here. And if you’re inspired to take up the fight to end weapons shipments to Israel, sign up to develop your own campaigns here! Join our Growth and Development Committee’s Organizing Trainings, Phonebanks, and More Starting Sunday 11/22 You can grow DSA to 150,000 members — and beyond! Join the Growth and Development Committee for a Fall Membership Drive Phonebank to ask lapsed members to renew: Fall Drive phonebank Sunday 11/22 at 5pm ET/4pm CT/3pm MT/2pm PT with Griffin Davis from Breaking Points. All attendees will receive a DSA sticker! Fall Drive phonebank on Sunday 11/29 at 5pm ET/4pm CT/3pm MT/2pm PT with Molly Crabapple. One lucky phonebanker will receive a signed copy of Molly’s new book Here Where We Live Is Our Country. Fall Drive phonebank with Professor Andre Pagliarini on Sunday 12/6 at 5pm ET/4pm CT/3pm MT/2pm PT. One lucky phonebanker will receive a signed copy of Professor Pagliarini’s book Lula: A People’s President and the Fight for Brazil’s Future. Fall Drive Phonebank on Sunday 12/13 at 5pm ET/4pm CT/3pm MT/2pm PT with Katie Halper. One lucky phonebanker will receive a DSA Store gift card! You can also join the Fundraising Committee for an End of Year Dues Drive phonebank to ask members to switch to monthly dues! End of Year Drive Giving Tuesday phonebank on Tuesday 12/1 at 7pm ET/6pm CT/5pm MT/4pm PT with the National Political Committee. One lucky phonebanker will receive a DSA Store gift card! End of Year Drive phonebank with Zac from The Vanguard Podcast on Thursday 12/10 at 7pm ET/6pm CT/5pm MT/4pm PT. All attendees will receive a DSA sticker! End of Year Drive phonebank with Adam Conover on Wednesday 12/16 at 7pm ET/6pm CT/5pm MT/4pm PT. One lucky phonebanker will receive tickets to an upcoming Adam Conover show! And check out the Growth and Development Committee’s upcoming trainings! Our core curriculum spans topics from meeting facilitation to membership engagement. And are you interested in taking on a leadership role in your DSA chapter? Already in a position of leadership, but looking to up your game? Attend the December Leadership Intensive Saturday 12/12 – Sunday 12/13. RSVP today! Give to DSA’s Venezuela Earthquake Solidarity Fund DSA stands in solidarity with the people of Venezuela and is fundraising to support their rescue and rebuilding efforts. The massive earthquakes on June 24 shook the people of Venezuela, and they’re still in need to rebuild and rescue those that have been missing after the earthquakes. The limited easing of sanctions by the US Treasury has been extended to early 2027, and we need your help. Donate today to support Venezuela’s rebuilding efforts. RSVP to National Political Education Committee Trainings Thursday 12/10, 12/17 Sign up for the final National Political Education Committee (NPEC) trainings for 2026! If you’re just starting chapter political education, need to train new political educators, or need a socialist pedagogy refresher, join us Thursday 12/10 at 8pm ET/7pm CT/6pm MT/5pm PT. The following week, learn how to run a childwatch group in your chapter! This call will be on Thursday 12/17 at 8pm ET/7pm CT/6pm MT/5pm PT. Apply to Join the National Grievance Panel, Committee of Grievance Officers Interested in helping support members and keep DSA a place free from harassment? Apply now to join the National Grievance Panel (NGP) and/or the Committee of Grievance Officers (CGO)! The National Grievance Panel reviews expulsions and appeals of local grievance outcomes to make recommendations to the NPC. The Committee of Grievance Officers provides support for local HGOs and the grievance process by facilitating trainings, creating resources, and building community among HGOs. Both groups are looking to welcome new members in this critical needs area for DSA. You can find a more detailed description of the roles and appointment process, contact the NGP or CGO with any questions, and apply on the form here. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until all open spots are filled or the end of January. Mutual Aid Working Group Logo Redesign Contest The Mutual Aid Working Group is opening submissions for a logo redesign! DSA MAWG is due for a makeover to keep up with the other working groups and committees’ logo designs. Click here to see the requirements and to submit your proposed logos! Welcome New Chapters and Organizing Committees! Let’s hear it for our comrades across the country!
